scenes.text: In 1982, a famous car boss opened a suitcase in a hotel room near L.A.X.
scenes.img: a dim 1980s hotel room at night, an open briefcase on a bed, a tall man in a dark suit seen from behind, cold fluorescent light
close-up of a hidden surveillance camera lens behind a hotel room air vent, red recording light, grainy VHS look

scenes.text: He was John DeLorean, the man behind the stainless steel car with gull-wing doors.
scenes.img: {car} parked alone on a rain-soaked street at night under a single streetlight

scenes.text: His company was out of money, and he was desperate.
scenes.img: an empty car factory floor at night with one unfinished stainless steel gull-wing car, dust and shadows

scenes.text: An informant offered him a deal to save it. It was an F.B.I. sting.
scenes.img: two men talking in a parked car at night, faces in shadow, rain-streaked windshield, city light bokeh

scenes.text: He was arrested on the spot, and the tape was played on TV around the world.
scenes.img: a 1982 living room lit only by a glowing CRT television showing a breaking news broadcast, silhouettes on a sofa

scenes.text: Two years later, a jury set him free.
scenes.img: a 1984 courtroom, a tall man in a suit seen from behind standing at the defense table, warm light

scenes.text: So why did he walk out a free man? Full story on Salimofff Garage.
